title: One entry of a coding agent's session (a line of a .jsonl file)
description: A tool-neutral record of one entry of a session with a coding agent: who it came from, when, in which folder, and which tool calls it started or returned results for. One JSON object per line; a file may hold any number of sessions. It carries no message text (a text field is invalid): what a person typed and what the agent answered never travel in this format. A reader ignores fields it doesn't know (a later v1 may add some). Entries of a branched or resumed session that repeat earlier ones keep the earlier entry's id, so a reader counts an id once. A call's duration is the time from the entry whose action names it (actions[].call) to the entry that lists it in results.

ts.description: When the entry was written, ISO 8601 with a time zone

session.description: The session's id; a subagent's entries carry the id of the session that started it or its own

role.description: human: a message the person actually sent (not injected context, not a message from another program or session, not the prompt of a run a program started); assistant: an entry the agent wrote; other: everything else (tool results, system entries, notifications)

id.description: The entry's own id, when the tool has one. An id names one entry: never reuse one for another entry, in this or any other session (a UUID, or the session's id plus a counter); a copy of an entry keeps its id

folder.description: The absolute working folder at this entry. A session belongs to the folder of its first entry that names one

subagent.description: An entry of a subagent the session started

actions.description: For role assistant: the tool calls this entry started

collab.description: Handing off to a subagent, running a workflow, messaging another session, using a skill; null for anything else

detail.description: The skill's name when collab is skill; empty otherwise

call.description: The call's id, named again in the results of the entry that returns it

results.description: The call ids whose results this entry returns
